$comment: The font SOURCES F-226's generator cuts the bundled faces from (scripts/generate-font-subset.mjs), each pinned by google/fonts commit and sha256, with its licence. The generator refuses a source whose sha256 differs: a font that changed upstream is a different font, and it is re-measured and re-recorded before it ships (ADR-0112). The sources are cached under .cache/fonts/ and NOT committed; the cut faces are. Noto Sans JP predates this file and is fetched as ADR-0057 describes.

faces.role: serif — the wordmark, display1, title and body where the mockups draw a serif (ADR-0106, ADR-0112)
mincho — the Japanese serif 20's card draws (C6, ADR-0112)
